title: Machine Luc switch table
summary: Read boolean switches from the TOML luc table and append missing choices without overwriting written lines. The machine config takes precedence over per-product Registry state on the next bootstrap.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: configured_path
operations.notes: Returns an expanded Path or None for absent/empty variable. No deadline.

operations.name: name_default
operations.notes: Mutates only an absent environment key for a signed-in Runtime. Explicit empty stays empty. No deadline.

operations.name: read_switches
operations.notes: No deadline. Missing, unreadable, linked, oversized or invalid TOML returns empty choices; nested dotted keys flatten to ids; only exact booleans count.

operations.name: record_switches
operations.notes: No deadline. Returns whether the file changed. Retries up to three compare-before-replace attempts; existing keys, including non-booleans, stay untouched. OSError can propagate; no structured Luc error.

invariants.text: A pre-existing key is never replaced by record_switches; other tables retain their source text.
Unreadable or malformed config contributes no switches and is not repaired.
The Runtime owns the [luc] table of config.toml. Every other writer (gemia/local_config.py, lumeri-cli) keeps that table unchanged and changes only its own tables (Acrab, 2026-10-24).

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Existing tests listed here were inspected, not run for this documentation task. The area checker validates the contract files; it does not exercise runtime behavior.

known_deviations.text: The inventory names a second writer in gemia/local_config.py. This checkout does not prove that external writer preserves this table; cross-repository behavior remains unverified.
Safe mode is controlled by LUMERI_LUC_SAFE_MODE=1 at the production call site, not by a luc.safe_mode boolean in this table.

open_questions.text: Confirm the two config writers share preservation and atomic-update semantics; document which repository owns that check.
